Implement MBOnce for three participant identities and two ordinary values. The winner returns INIT, another participant BUSY and recursive owner entry RECURSIVE. Only the owner finishes. Success publishes17,34; READY readers copy both. Permanent failure becomes stable FAILED; the separately configured retry policy returns to EMPTY after failure. No reader sees a partial object.
